intro.headline: The fine print, _in plain words._
intro.lede: Straight answers on billing, your data and moving over from whatever you use now. If one is missing, ask the people who wrote them.

items.q: Is there a free trial, and does it need a card?

a.p: Every new workspace gets **30 days of Studio**, our middle plan, with no card on file. On day 30 you choose a plan, or the workspace drops to Solo, which is free for one person for as long as you like. Nothing is deleted either way.

items.q: What happens if we add people in the middle of a month?

a.p: You pay for the days the seat exists, not the whole month. The next invoice shows each change on its own line, so your accountant can follow it.

items.q: Can we pay yearly, by bank transfer?

a.p: From 10 seats on a yearly plan we send a PDF invoice with 30-day terms and our bank details. Below 10 seats, yearly is card only.
Prices are shown without VAT. Inside the EU we add it unless you give us a valid VAT number; then the invoice is reverse-charged and says so.

items.q: Can we export everything and leave?

a.p: One export holds every timesheet, client, project and invoice, as CSV plus the original PDFs. It works on every plan, including after a plan has lapsed.

steps: Pick a date range, or leave it on **Everything**.
We email a download link within 10 minutes. It stays valid for 7 days.

a.p: In two data centres in Frankfurt, with nightly encrypted backups kept for 35 days. Nothing is copied outside the EU.

items.q: Can anyone at Fernwork read our timesheets?
items.short: Only if you ask us to

a.p: Support can open your workspace only after an admin grants access from **Settings → Security**. Access ends after 72 hours, and every view is logged where your admins can see it.

items.q: How long does it take to move from spreadsheets or another tracker?

a.p: Most studios are tracking on day one. Bring a CSV from wherever you are now.

steps: Export your projects and time entries as CSV.
Drop the file on **Import** and match the columns. We guess most of them.
Check the preview, then import. It can be undone for 24 hours.
Invite the team. Their history comes with them.

items.q: Will our invoice numbers carry on?

a.p: Set the next number once (for example `2026-0148`) and Fernwork carries on from there, in your format.

items.q: Will you help us set it up?

a.p: A 45-minute call with someone who has run a studio. We import your data with you and set up your rates and invoice templates.

contact.headline: Still stuck? _Ask the people who wrote this._
contact.text: Every message is read and answered by one of the three people who wrote these answers. First reply within **4 working hours**; last month the median was **1 h 52 min**.
